TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: reads pricingRuleId from the request as a Long and calls ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId); inside the library it loads the pricing rule by id, populates the values of its details and validates that the rule exists and that its status is PAA, PAU or PAD. 2. Decisions and branches: if the rule status is PAA or PAU, the library changes it to REJ; if the status is PAD, it changes it to SYC; if pricingRuleResponse is null, setPricingrule skips the output assignment. 3. Libraries and invoked methods: ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId) gets the next audit id, obtains the request user code, inserts an audit row and updates the pricing rule status in the repository. 4. Errors and follow-up actions: when the library catches a PricingRuleException, it adds the corresponding advice with its description; after the library call, if getAdviceList() is not empty, the transaction sets severity EWR. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, the transaction assigns it to pricingRuleResponse after the status update and detail value population.
